chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, who said: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated to us, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from al-Fadlata, from al-Aban, from Abu Ja'far al-Ahwal, from Bashar ibn Yasar, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him):
Why do you not fast on Wednesday? He said: Because the Fire was created on Wednesday.
ai.seo_question: Why does Imam al-Sadiq avoid fasting on Wednesdays?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Al-Khisal*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be him) links the avoidance of fasting on Wednesdays to the creation of Hellfire on that day, reflecting the Shia tradition of *takhayyur* (selecting auspicious times) and *takhayyur* (avoiding inauspicious ones). This practice underscores the belief that specific days carry metaphysical qualities influencing spiritual states, a concept rooted in both Quranic exegesis and Imami hadith literature.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 7-75 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Sa’id, on the authority of Fuzalat, on the authority of Aban, on the authority of Abi Ja’far al-Ahwal, on the authority of Bashar ibn Yasar, “I asked Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB), ‘
Why do you always fast on Wednesdays?’ The Imam (MGB) replied, ‘Since the Fire (of Hell) was created on a Wednesday.’”
